gallery.title: File:PNG-Japanese-Nakajima-Ki-49-Hellen-Oct-2002-11.jpg
gallery.description: Nakajima Ki-49 Hellen abandoned after a US air raid on Madang. The airfield was totally unserviceable and several aircraft where just left. The airfield is far bigger then Madangs current airfield but to restore this airfield would cost too much. Judging by the size of the creators left they must of use 500lb bombs during the raid.

gallery.title: File:Lowland Peltops.jpg
gallery.description: Lowland Peltops Peltops blainvillii, Madang, Papua New Guinea. A flycatcher-like bird which is in the same family as Butcherbirds (Artamidae)  They make a very unusual noise, hence the other common name of "clicking shieldbill".

gallery.title: File:Curved Mistletoe (3690327343).jpg
gallery.description:
Loranthaceae (mistletoe family) » Dendrophthoe falcata
den-droff-THOH-ee -- from the Greek dendron (tree) and phthoe (to waste away)
fal-KAY-tuh -- sickle-shaped
commonly known as: curved mistletoe, honey suckle mistletoe • Bengali: baramanda, পরগাছা paragaacha • Garo: tuthekmi • Gujarati: વંદો vando • Hindi: बंदा banda, बंदा पाठा banda patha, बन्दाल bandal • Kannada: ಬಮ್ದಣಿಕೆ bamdanike, ಮದುಕ maduk • Konkani: bemdram • Malayalam: ഇത്തിള്‍ iththil, ഇത്തിക്കണ്ണി ittikkanni • Marathi: बांडगुळ bandgul, बाशिंगी bashingi • Oriya: ବନ୍ଦା banda • Punjabi: amut • Sanskrit: वंदा vanda, वृक्षादनी vrksadani, वृक्षरुहा vrksaruha • Tamil: புல்லுரீ pulluri, புல்லுருவி pulluruvi, உசீ uchi • Telugu: జిద్దూ jiddu, యెలింగా yelinga
Native to: Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka

References: Flowers of India • ENVIS - FRLHT
